# sheet-llm

Chat-driven music notation editor. A natural-language request is turned by an
LLM orchestrator into *additive* edit operations against a canonical JSON
`Score`; the score is rendered to staff notation via abcjs, played back through
a transport, and exported to MusicXML / MIDI / PDF. The core invariant is
additive editing: the system never silently replaces work the user did not ask
to discard — enforced by server-side preservation verification plus a
replacement-as-confirmation gate. All docs below carry YAML frontmatter with
`source_paths` so staleness is detectable mechanically (this file, llms.txt,
does not).

## Docs

### Architecture
- [System Architecture Overview](architecture/overview.md): end-to-end map from app shell to orchestrator to score to render/play/export.
- [Request Lifecycle](architecture/data-flow.md): step-by-step data flow for a chat edit, an import, and an export.
- [The Score Data Model](architecture/data-model.md): canonical `Score` JSON — measures, events, spans, IDs, validation, migration.
- [Glossary](architecture/glossary.md): domain and system terms (additive edit, SourceMap, sticky provider, score version).

### Subsystems
- [LLM Orchestrator](subsystems/orchestrator.md): tool-use dispatch, preservation verifier, replacement gate, budget/deadline.
- [LLM Providers & Failover](subsystems/providers-llm.md): registry, tiered selection, sticky routing, degradation, failover.
- [Music Data Model & Validation](subsystems/music-model.md): types, validators, accessors, meter, spans, techniques, articulations.
- [Edit Operations & Score Transforms](subsystems/edit-operations.md): edit-op catalog, structural ops, measure balancing, diffing.
- [Score-to-ABC, SourceMap & abcjs Rendering](subsystems/abc-rendering.md): Score→ABC emit, SourceMap round-trip, abcjs render/synth.
- [Notation Editor UI & Interactions](subsystems/editor-ui.md): click/drag/keyboard editing, staff geometry, popovers, floating menu.
- [Command Palette (Cmd-K)](subsystems/command-palette.md): command catalog, palette UI, dispatch bus into editor/chat state.
- [AI Ghost Preview (M24)](subsystems/ghost-preview.md): inline amber overlay, docked diff panel, accept/reject, 30s resume toast.
- [Chat & Session State (client)](subsystems/chat-session.md): client chat store, prompt submit/phase, transcript sync, persistence queue.
- [Transport & Playback](subsystems/transport.md): transport state machine, cursor, scrubber, event-time index, MIDI/ping audio.
- [Score Import Pipeline](subsystems/import.md): format detect → ABC/MIDI/JSON → normalized `Score`, import modal/preview.
- [Export — MusicXML, MIDI, PDF](subsystems/export.md): MusicXML emit, MIDI/PDF generation, export bar.
- [Persistence, Schema & Score Versioning](subsystems/persistence-db.md): Drizzle schema, conversations, score versions, fork/revert, janitor.
- [Auth, Sessions & GDPR](subsystems/auth-gdpr.md): anonymous sessions, recovery codes, rate limiting, GDPR export/delete.
- [Billing & Prepaid Credits](subsystems/billing.md): hosted-only credit paywall (dark by default), metering→cost-plus wallet (hold/settle/refund), Stripe top-ups+webhook, in-process reconcile/reap janitor, GDPR export. Self-host=BYOK.
- [App Shell, Routes & Boot](subsystems/app-shell.md): root layout, boot/instrumentation, recovery boot, page composition.
- [Testing & Eval Harness](subsystems/evals-testing.md): Vitest configs, factories, mock/live/visual evals, local check commands.

## Conventions

- Additive edits only. Never silently replace the user's score. Wholesale
  rewrites are gated behind the replacement-as-confirmation modal; retained
  measures are verified server-side by hash (`src/lib/orchestrator/preservationVerifier.ts`).
  The LLM is never trusted to self-report preservation.
- Schema-drift discipline. The `Score` type (`src/lib/music/types.ts`) is the
  contract; changing it means updating validators, migration
  (`src/lib/music/migrateScoreV1.ts`), Score→ABC, MusicXML export, and the data-model doc.
- Read `node_modules/next/dist/docs/` before writing any Next.js code. This
  repo's Next has breaking changes vs. common training data; heed deprecation notices.
- Frontmatter freshness. Every doc except this file carries YAML frontmatter
  with `source_paths`. When you touch a file, update the doc(s) listing it and
  bump `last_verified` / `verified_against`. Coverage is tracked in
  `_meta/coverage.md`; the rules live in `_meta/STYLE_GUIDE.md` and
  `ai-agents/maintenance-protocol.md`.
